-## Testing Guidelines
-- **Unit Testing Strategy**: We are moving towards co-locating unit tests with the files and modules they test. Create test files adjacent to the source (e.g., `module.test.ts` next to `module.ts`).
-- **Legacy & E2E**: While end-to-end tests currently reside in `tests/e2e/`, we are shifting away from heavy reliance on this centralized structure for logic verification. Prioritize co-located unit tests for new features.
-- Playwright specs live in `tests/e2e/`; base URL is `http://127.0.0.1:3000` and the config auto-starts the dev server. Record screenshots or traces only on failure by default.
-- When adding UI, include at least one Playwright path that covers the new flow and assert on visible text/ARIA roles instead of CSS selectors when possible.

-## WORKFLOW MODES: PLAN, BUILD, TASK
-1. At onset of each new conversation ask what mode we are in to confirm.
-**Ambiguity?** Always ASK which mode applies if unsure.
+- **Never build in PLAN**:
+  - PLAN may edit **planning artifacts** only (typically under `plans/` and optionally `docs/`).
+  - PLAN must **not** change product code under `src/`, `lib/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`.
+  - Meta exception: PLAN may evolve the OS itself under `.cursor/`.
 
-### PLAN | Planning Mode
-1. **Kickoff**: Ask if this is a continuation of an existing plan or a new plan. In the same message, list all current plans by enumerating the folders containing `EPIC` under `/docs/sprint-artifacts/`.
-2. **Single Plan Source of Truth**: Maintain exactly one plan document per conversation. If continuing, update the existing plan file; if new, create one new plan file.
-3. **Context Preservation / No Doc Sprawl**: Put decisions, assumptions, open questions, and scope in that single plan file. Do not create additional planning docs unless explicitly requested.
-4. **Plan Location (for new plans)**: Create it at `/docs/sprint-artifacts/EPIC# - <plan-name>/<Plan-Title>.PLAN.md` where `#` is the next EPIC number; the folder name is the plan name.
-5. **Optional Ticket Sharding**: Ask whether to shard (without deleting the original plan) into ticket files. If yes, create `TICKET# - <story-name>.md` files from plan sections.
+- **Build mode (ticketed work)**:
+  - Product code changes are allowed only if `project.current_mode: build` and `execution.current_ticket` is set.
 
-### BUILD | Developer Mode
-1. **Check Directory**: Before creating anything, check `/docs/sprint-artifacts` and ask me which plan we want to execute do today, or create a new one, each plan should correspond to a folder in this directory. 
-2. **Shard to Tickets**: Ask me which of the tickets do we want to build today, ask me to select from all the files which have TICKET in them. If there are no such files ask for guidance.
-3. **Execute & Document**: As you implement each ticket, you MUST log progress, issues, and workarounds directly in that ticket's md file, htis is critical, because we want to avoid compaction issues, and I will monitor closely. If you have doubts, run into walls, note. Really every meaninful action we do should result in an entry to this file. We want to be concise as compaction will matter. We will dial this in as we work together.
+- **Task mode (one-off work)**:
+  - Product code changes are allowed only if `project.current_mode: task` and `execution.current_task` is set.
 
-### TASK | One-off Task Mode
-1. **Simple Execution**: Ignore Plan/Build workflows. Just perform the specific task requested.
+## Ticket structure rules (BMAD-derived)
 
+All tickets must follow `plans/templates/ticket.md`.
 
+- **Acceptance Criteria ↔ Tasks mapping is mandatory**:
+  - Every **top-level task** must include `(AC: AC-#...)`.

+  - Never mark `[x]` unless the work exists and validations/tests pass.
